test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the pair which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

JLO−QSV

TVY−ACF
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3144362545c475af3a53d126dede18dbb3d3fb4241541a63f179a8799ae8f525.png] 

Logic followed here is: Each letter in the second group is obtained by adding 7 to the positional value of the corresponding letter in the first group.

**For**

**JLO is related to QSV →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a18944f65d7fee93afb194ca6be1780e5a8667671ac9965fa1c975d6751ab18f.png] 

**TVY is related to ACF →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31cd57da6a7ffbb405c1fa571d2a604c674bfc40dedc377159cc0768f96ccbc5.png] 

 

**Option 2) NPS - UWZ:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/007bd96fb66beaf20f010f3548d5a0b41897afe35b44512e37400a6e90b8c4a1.png] 

Therefore, the pair that follows the same pattern is NPS-UWZ.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
